ports.label: BIOS FlashBack
ports.hint: Update BIOS from USB without CPU/RAM in some scenarios — read ASUS guide first.

ports.label: Clear CMOS
ports.hint: Resets BIOS settings. Use if a bad overclock or failed flash bricks POST.

ports.label: HDMI
ports.hint: iGPU video out when CPU has graphics (14900K does).

ports.label: USB-A 2.0 (top pair)
ports.hint: Good for keyboards, mice, low-power dongles.

ports.label: USB-A 2.0 (bottom pair)
ports.hint: Same controller family as top 2.0 pair.

ports.label: Thunderbolt / USB-C
ports.hint: High-bandwidth docks, eGPU-class links, fast external SSDs. Prefer for big data transfers.

ports.label: USB-A 3.2 Gen2
ports.hint: Blue/teal high-speed Type-A — better for external SSDs than 2.0 ports.

ports.label: USB-C 3.2
ports.hint: Rear Type-C without full Thunderbolt branding — still high speed.

ports.label: Ethernet 2.5G
ports.hint: Wired LAN. Link flaps show up in Event Viewer as ethernet-link theme.

ports.label: Analog audio jacks
ports.hint: Line out / mic / surround jacks (Realtek stack + ASUS software).
